observations: The project description emphasizes the importance of transparency, community engagement, and effective communication between citizens, municipal operators, and external maintenance personnel.

The existing high-level goals provide a good foundation for the system's functionality, but some aspects, such as citizen-to-citizen engagement and municipal operator-to-citizen communication, require additional goals to ensure comprehensive coverage.
